matches.title: Compute exact rational matrix rank
matches.description: Compute the rank and RREF pivot columns of one rectangular matrix over QQ.

matches.title: Compute exact symbolic matrix rank over QQ(t_1, ..., t_n)
matches.description: Compute the rank and RREF pivot columns of a rectangular matrix whose entries are rational functions in declared algebraically independent variables, using SymPy's exact row reduction.

matches.title: Reconstruct an exact polygon visibility kernel
matches.description: Intersect the closed left half-plane of each edge of one bounded simple CCW rational polygon. Return source-bound oriented inequalities and vertex turns; the canonical empty, point, segment, or polygon kernel; the polygon convex hull; exact polygon, kernel, and hull areas; and rational area ratios. Admission allows 64 vertices and 64 digits per coordinate component, then bounds pairwise feasibility work, coefficient/intersection growth, and output before expansion. No perimeter or theorem-level claim.

matches.title: Compute an exact rational polytope support value
matches.description: For a full-dimensional rational polytope with one labelled coordinate axis and a complete irredundant V-representation, compute the exact support value h_P(u)=max_{x in P}<u,x> and return every maximizing vertex as the complete exposed face. The exact support kernel is one bounded vertex-by-covector pass; the V-value separately proves that each supplied generator is an extreme vertex before evaluation.

matches.title: Compute an exact rational solution
matches.description: Return an exact rational solution or an inconsistent outcome.
